topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Rain's been pouring down harder than a broken faucet all night, seeping through the cracks like it's trying to wash the whole damn city away. Got a call from a dame, says she found a pile of old stuff in the attic of her new place. Old family pictures, letters, some toys. She sounds like she's on the edge, like maybe she's holding onto something that's not there anymore. Told her I'm on my way, but I know what I'll find—just another house full of echoes where the people are gone, and the things they left behind can't bring them back. Took me a long time to learn that trick, but there it is. I'll drive over, take a look, and maybe find a way to close another door for her. Rain's not letting up, but at least it'll keep the ghosts from coming out to play.
